title: Return, iii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. Gully's. The pup meets the end stool. He can't get up it. Wood lifts him. Gully looks at the stool's height and says nothing yet; the crate is three weeks off.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the end stool. BARNABY II at its foot, looking up the leg like a cliff. GULLY. The girl, five, on the counter.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged puppy at the foot of a tall shop stool looking up its leg, a thin man on the stool, a man in an apron, a five-year-old girl sitting on the counter

panels.composition: Wood reaching down. Lifting. The pup onto the lap, instantly asleep — no. Instantly awake, looking at the girl.

characters.pose: on the lap, looking at the girl

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man lifting a small three-legged puppy onto his lap on a stool where it looks alertly at a girl on the counter

panels.composition: The girl and the pup, eye to eye. Gully watching the stool's height. Measuring, in his head.

characters.pose: eye to eye with the pup

balloons.text: Nobody knows. He came that way.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a five-year-old girl and a small three-legged puppy looking at each other at a counter while a man in an apron eyes the stool's height
image.notes: 'He came that way.' The leg: reserved beyond this.

balloons.text: He's a regular. He gets a cup.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man in an apron pouring a coffee and setting a second small cup beside it for a puppy on a thin man's lap

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
